info.name: Bridge API (Bridge Data Output) Agents Open Houses API
Query open houses for a dataset

params.name: dataset_id
params.description: The dataset identifier the request is scoped to.

params.name: access_token
params.description: Bridge access token. Optional when an Authorization Bearer header is supplied.

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of records to return per page.

params.name: offset
params.description: Number of records to skip for pagination.

params.name: fields
params.description: Comma-separated list of fields to include in each record.

params.name: sortBy
params.description: Field name to sort results by.

items.docs: Returns scheduled open house records, including date and time window and the associated listing. Supports filtering, field selection, sorting, and pagination.
